_doc: Completed T-0482 ledger. Every manifest member has a dated outcome. Detailed evidence, queries, URLs, and notes are retained in the committed workbook/CSV package.

hobson_jesse.summary: Jesse Hobson was living in Cook County in 1835 and married Catherine Daugherty at Naperville on April 6, 1835.

morgan_jesse.summary: Competing identity: Jesse Morgan, Porter County, Indiana settler from 1833 whose house became a Chicago–Detroit stage station.

lucas_robert.summary: Possible identity: Robert Lucas, an early Palos settler, reportedly settled there about 1834.

elias_maynar.summary: Possible duplicate/transcription relationship with existing resident ID maynard_elias; Elias Maynard is also named among 1834 Bloomingdale-area settlers.

russel_john.summary: Possible identity: John Russel, associated with a farm near the Palos/Lemont area in 1834.

silas_meacham.summary: Possible identity: Silas Meacham, early settler at Meacham's Grove; later served as Chicago lighthouse keeper.

orsemus_morrison.summary: Orsemus Morrison came to Chicago in 1833, acquired school-section property, and worked as a mechanic/builder.
